g.text: Independent velocity BEM on the identical computed contour
213 panels; all cavity samples retained. Hess-Smith independently solves velocity,
whereas the current solver solves mixed potential boundary conditions. Neither curve is experiment.
On the same contour at N = 213: lift difference 0.00474 (~0.94% of Hess-Smith); speed-target RMS 0.00664 U.
This is an independent prescribed-contour diagnostic. The full independent free-boundary benchmark has NOT PASSED.
